description: This Java class defines the DeleteAttributeStrategy, which handles the DeleteAttribute command in a persistence layer of an Eclipse Ditto services project. It manages the deletion of attributes from a Thing entity, producing appropriate results and events.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the deletion of attributes from a Thing, implementing the command handling logic.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete attribute command, checking for attribute existence and generating the appropriate result or error.

methods.name: getDeleteAttributeResult
methods.description: Creates a mutation result with an AttributeDeleted event and response, representing the successful deletion.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the EntityTag of the attribute before deletion, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional since no entity tag is applicable after deletion.

search-terms: Immutable Java class for command handling
